subject: general
question: According to the passage, which of the following are the two main reasons of species becoming endangered species?

options.text: Loss of sunlight and Loss of water
Loss of roads and loss of hunting grounds
Loss of habitat and Loss of genetic variation

solution:
The correct answer is "**Loss of habitat and Loss of genetic variation**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We are required to select the set of reasons behind the species becoming endangered.
 
• Now, refer to the following lines from the passage:
 
 
• Line 1 of paragraph 1: Species become endangered for** two main reasons: loss of habitat and loss of genetic variation.**
 
 
 
• **​**Loss of genetic variation can occur when a population becomes too small or isolated, making it more vulnerable to diseases and environmental changes.
 
• Both of these factors can be caused by human activities and can lead to the extinction of species
 
• From the highlighted part in the above given line:
 
 
• **it can be concluded that the reason behind the species becoming endangered is mentioned in option 3.**
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
